platformMatrix.windows: native-resolver: resolve the complete canonical URI before opening
platformMatrix.web: controlled-frame-lifecycle: no top-level custom-scheme navigation; observe visibilitychange or pagehide and clean up on timeout
platformMatrix.extension: controlled-frame-lifecycle: no top-level custom-scheme navigation; observe visibilitychange or pagehide and clean up on timeout

meaning.installed: A native platform resolver confirmed a handler only. It does not prove review, approval, callback, session or account access.
meaning.opened: A Web/Extension lifecycle transition was observed only. It does not prove a handler, review, approval, callback, session or account access.
meaning.unsupported: No supported browser launcher or native handler resolver was available.
meaning.timeout: The controlled Web/Extension attempt caused no lifecycle transition before cleanup.

sessionPolicy: This launcher never creates, restores or implies a Product Session. Standard Wallet connectivity remains independent.
